chemicalCosts.title: Chemical Costs Report
chemicalCosts.description: PDF of chemical costs by client and pool for a date range.
chemicalCosts.configurationHint: Select a company, clients, and date range
chemicalCosts.noClientsDescription: No clients are available. Please ensure clients exist in the system.
chemicalCosts.noClientsForCompanyDescription: No clients found for the selected company ({company}). Please select a different company or ensure clients are assigned to this company.
chemicalCosts.infoDescription: The report will include all chemical costs for the selected clients and pools within the specified date range. Only services with consumables defined will be included in the report.
chemicalCosts.clientsRequiredDescription: Please select at least one client.
chemicalCosts.dateRangeRequiredDescription: Please select both from and to dates.
chemicalCosts.invalidDateRangeDescription: From date must be before or equal to to date.
chemicalCosts.generatedDescription: Chemical costs report has been downloaded successfully.
chemicalCosts.generateErrorDescription: Failed to generate report. Please try again.

technicianReport.title: Service report by technician
technicianReport.description: Download a PDF of completed services and pay for one technician.
technicianReport.filtersHint: Select company, technician, and date range
technicianReport.percentageOfPayment: Percentage of the pool''s monthly payment
technicianReport.amountExplanation: Services will be calculated considering payment unit settled in the pool multiplied by the fixed amount set here.
technicianReport.amountExample: If you set $10.00 here and Pool A has 2 payment units while Pool B has 3 payment units, Pool A will pay $20.00 per service (2 × $10.00) and Pool B will pay $30.00 per service (3 × $10.00).
technicianReport.percentageExplanation: Enter the percentage of the pool''s monthly payment that should be paid per service. For example, if you want to pay 70% of the monthly payment for weekly services, enter 16.2% (70% ÷ 4.33 weeks).
technicianReport.adjustmentsHint: Add extras or discounts to the report total. Leave amount at 0 to skip.
technicianReport.discountsPlaceholder: e.g. Credit adjustment for missed service
technicianReport.descriptionRequired: Description is required when amount is greater than 0
technicianReport.generateError: Failed to generate report. Please try again.
